blocks.text: Points P₂ aur P₄ par compression rarefaction se milta hai, is liye superposition ke principle ke mutabiq dono ek doosre ka effect khatam kar dete hain aur resultant displacement zero ho jata hai, jaisa Fig. 7.5(d) mein hai.
Points P₂ aur P₄ par dono waves ka path difference ΔS yeh hai:
Isi tarah P₄ par bhi path difference ½λ hai.

blocks.title: Destructive interference
blocks.text: Jin points par do waves ke displacements ek doosre ko khatam kar dein, wahan path difference aadhi wavelength ka odd (taaq) multiple hota hai (½λ, 3/2 λ, 5/2 λ, …). Is effect ko destructive interference kehte hain.
Is liye destructive interference ki condition yeh hai:

blocks.title: Example 7.1
blocks.problem: Do speakers figure ki tarah rakhe hain. Un ke beech ka faasla 3.0 m hai aur woh 344 Hz ki constant (mustaqil) tone (sound) nikalte hain. Ek microphone P ko speakers ko milane wali line ke parallel aur us se 4.0 m door ek line par chalaya jata hai. Sab se oonchi sound tab sunai deti aur CRO par nazar aati hai jab microphone line ke beech (centre) mein ho aur jab har speaker ke bilkul saamne ho. Sound ki speed nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: S₁S₂ = 3.0 m, f = 344 Hz, speakers se P ki line tak faasla S₁P = 4.0 m, v = ?
Sab se oonchi sound (constructive interference) ke liye path difference 0, ±1λ, ±2λ, ±3λ, … hona chahiye.
Beech wale point O par dono sound waves ka path difference zero hai (S₁O = S₂O), is liye O par constructive interference hota hai.
Agla constructive point P hai, jahan path difference λ hona chahiye: λ = S₂P₁ − S₁P₁.
Right-angled triangle S₁S₂P₁ se (Pythagoras theorem): S₂P₁ = √((S₁S₂)² + (S₁P₁)²) = √((3)² + (4)²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 m.
Is liye λ = S₂P₁ − S₁P₁ = 5 − 4 = 1 m. Yahi constructive interference ka path difference hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: signal generator do speakers S2 (oopar) aur S1 (neeche) se jura. Un ke beech se ek lakeer 4.0 m door khari lakeer par nuqta O tak; us lakeer par S1 ke saamne microphone P, CRO se jura. Us ke neeche, daen taraf: hindse (geometry) ka khaaka, ek mustateel (rectangle): S2 aur S1 3 m door, lakeer 4 m door; O us lakeer par beech se thora neeche, P S1 ke saamne aur ek aur nuqta S2 ke saamne; lakeeren S2O, S1O aur S1 se S2 ke saamne wale nuqte tak tirchhi lakeer.
blocks.caption: Example 7.1 (PDF page 145): 3.0 m door do speakers aur 4.0 m door lakeer par chalta microphone (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O beech mein hai, is liye S₁O = S₂O aur path difference zero: oonchi sound. P, S₁ ke bilkul saamne hai: S₁P = 4 m, aur right-angled triangle S₁S₂P se S₂P = 5 m, to farq 1 m = λ.

blocks.title: Example 7.2
blocks.problem: Ek radio transmitter ke signal ki wavelength 1500 m aur frequency 200 kHz hai. 1000 kHz par chalne wale transmitter ki wavelength kya hogi, aur radio waves kis speed se chalti hain?
steps: Diya gaya: λ₁ = 1500 m = 1.5 × 10³ m, f₁ = 200 kHz = 2.0 × 10⁵ Hz, f₂ = 1000 kHz = 1 × 10⁶ Hz; λ₂ = ?, v = ?; formula v = fλ.
Dono signals ki speed barabar hai (dono radio waves hain), is liye: v = f₁λ₁ = 2.0 × 10⁵ × 1500 = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.
Doosre signal ke liye bhi v = f₂λ₂, to λ₂ = v/f₂ = (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1 × 10⁶ Hz).
blocks.answer: λ₂ = 3 × 10² m = 300 m, aur speed v = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. Frequency 5 guna hui to wavelength 5 guna kam ho gayi (1500 m se 300 m).

Monochromatic light (ek rang ki roshni)
Shole (flame) mein sodium chloride pure (khalis) peeli light deta hai. Yeh light red aur green ka mixture nahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Interference hone ki conditions (sharait) kya hain, aur coherent waves aur coherent sources kya hain (short questions 7.1, 7.3)? Constructive aur destructive interference mein farq bataiye (short question 7.2).
blocks.explanation: Sources coherent hon, yaani ek hi frequency aur constant phase difference wale (jaise ek generator se chalne wale do speakers); waves ek hi qism ki, taqreeban barabar amplitude ki hon, aur ek hi jagah (region) mein milein. Constructive interference wahan hai jahan path difference wavelengths ka whole number (poora adad) ho, to crest crest se (compression compression se) milta hai aur amplitude barhta hai; destructive wahan jahan aadhi wavelengths ka odd number (taaq adad) ho, to crest trough se milta hai aur waves khatam ho jati hain.

rows: Crest crest se (compression compression se) milta hai
Crest trough se (compression rarefaction se) milta hai
Displacements jama ho kar amplitude barhta hai
Displacements ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain
Sound loud; CRO par bara displacement
Sound khatam ya bohat dheemi; CRO par zero displacement

items: Interference: ek jaisi frequency aur ek hi direction wali do waves ki superposition; coherent sources ek hi phase mein vibrate karte hain.
Constructive: ΔS = nλ, CRO par bara displacement. Destructive: ΔS = (2n + 1) λ/2, CRO par zero displacement.
Example 7.1: S₂P = 5 m, λ = 1 m, v = 344 m s⁻¹. Example 7.2: v = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, λ₂ = 3 × 10² m.
